site.name: MeerKAT array phase centre
site.source: SARAO, MeerKAT specifications (skaafrica.atlassian.net, ESDKB page 277315585): array phase centre 30d42m39.8s S, 21d26m38.0s E, 1086.6 m; dish 13.5 m nominal

beam.source: Mauch et al. 2020, ApJ 888, 61, section 2.2, equation 4 (circularised L-band half-power width 57.5 arcmin at 1.5 GHz, scaling as 1/frequency); applied to UHF and S by the lambda/D scaling de Villiers 2023, AJ 165, 78 reports over most of each band

geometry: zenith range: residual / altitude, the largest angle the residual subtends from the site

windows.storm: May 2024 storm, sets issued 6 to 13 May
windows.held-out: October 2024 storm, sets issued 6 to 13 October (held out)
windows.august: August 2024 storm, sets issued 8 to 15 August (held out)

definitions.crossing_horizon: governed by the cross-track error: the longest lead through which at least `coverage` of a band's trials keep their cross-track angular error under `beam_fraction` of the half-power width; whether an object crossed the beam during an observation, its time known to along_shift_p95_s
definitions.position_horizon: governed by the along-track error: the same coverage applied to the along-track angular error; where an object is at an instant to within `beam_fraction` of the beam
